game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail, the trail at the snowline: the sherpa guide must handle avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – F-String Herald: Format messages with f-strings that insert live values for announcements.
theme: Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail: the trail at the snowline
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowline Trail, repeat each round: Format messages with f-strings that insert live values for announcements. Each round, avalanches strike the rescue sled, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the announcements value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rescue sled from avalanches in Snowline Trail: keep the announcements meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: announcements drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 34-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 5 (applied tier): F-String Herald
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'F-String Herald' (Week 8 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Snowline Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how announcements changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against avalanches in Snowline Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 34 seconds while announcements > 0.
